name: Introdemo
source:
It's about the story of a punk rock idol and a late night TV show host begrudgingly joining forces to solve the biggest murder mystery of the decade. It's the 70s, little fool, don't forget the golden rule.

[From [url=https://dotssu.itch.io/introdemo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名朋克摇滚偶像与一名深夜电视节目主持人，心不甘情不愿地联手，调查十年来最轰动的谋杀悬案。小傻瓜，这可是20世纪70年代，别忘了那条金科玉律。

[摘自[url=https://dotssu.itch.io/introdemo]Itch.io[/url]]
